thread:
emily: Quick sync - bringing up zenith7b (7B) on int3 pipeline. Smoke found a subtle hallucination reg in our API evals (QA F1 down ~5%).

ravi: Any initial suspects? quant noise, vocab mismatch, or rotary?

emily: Repro attached. FP16 vs INT3 compare on a standard openqa set: top-1 answer match 88% -> 81% on int3. Logits early tokens look fine, divergence happens after two dense layers in block 8.

nina: Did you check projector ordering? We recently added support for 'proj_layout=split' in some community forks.

emily: I dumped param names; exporter kept names but we lost a custom attr: "rotary_basis_order" in the checkpoint metadata. Converter drops unknown attrs.

ci-bot: ONBOARD: zenith7b-int3 -> SMOKE FAILED. Ticket INF-3410 created.

jon: If rotary_basis_order is wrong, kv indexing will pick wrong cosine/sine pairs -> subtle shift in attention phase. That could flip top answer for some prompts.

emily: I did a quick emulation: reapply fp16 rotary basis ordering to int3 weights before running inference. Match rate jumps to 87.6%.

ravi: So cause is exporter attr loss + aggressive quant rounding? any evidence of token id mapping differences?

emily: Tokenizer matches. However converter also applied an in-place permute for proj blocks to optimize memory and we didn't invert that for the small int3 kernel. So two bugs: missing rotary attr and permute mismatch.

nina: Proposed mitigation: 1) change converter to persist any custom checkpoint attrs into model-manifest under 'raw_attrs' 2) disable proj permute for int kernels until we add a loader shim 3) add CI gate that runs fp16->quant fidelity check on 128 examples (cosine similarity > 0.995 on embeds + logits pearson > 0.99 early tokens).

emily: I'll open PRs. Also adding a targeted eval for QA abundance-flip cases to capture this class of regression.

ci-bot: PR opened: preserve-checkpoint-attrs (#1107)

jon: Nice. Add a small triage note: how to detect in the future - run per-head rotary phase check: dump first 4 sin/cos pairs and compare against fp16 canonical ordering. If mismatch -> fail.
\nemily: adding runbook now and will push converter patch. Will re-run onboarding after CI
